facts.text: The Take Flight Program covers undergraduate tuition for eligible Ohio residents with a Student Aid Index of 2,200 or less, and provides a personal laptop and a $100 annual textbook voucher.

sources.title: Take Flight Program | Enrollment Services - Wright State University
sources.quote: In addition to covering the cost of undergraduate tuition, the program also provides the following benefits: Personal laptop for each participant. $100 textbook voucher for each year of participation.
